evidence.summary: Official Birmingham selection methods are combined with official 2025-entry historical interview statistics. Numerical bands are conservative historical guidance only, are not current cut-offs and do not make interview outcomes deterministic. SJT is excluded from pre-interview selection.

eligibility.scope: Guidance is available only after every applicable production eligibility rule passes and exactly one supported Birmingham applicant pool is safely resolved.
eligibility.readiness_reason: The configuration can provide explicitly warned historical guidance for supported Home and International applicants and a deterministic UKWPMED override when every required fact is verified. It cannot provide a current-cycle cut-off, a numerical Graduate band, an automated International non-academic decision or an offer prediction.
pre_banding_order: Evaluate the applicable academic and fee-status eligibility rules in the Birmingham production profile.
Require UCAT to have been taken in the application cycle; do not apply a minimum UCAT eligibility cut-off where Birmingham publishes none.
Ignore SJT for eligibility, pool resolution and interview selection, including SJT Band 4.
Apply the UKWPMED guaranteed-interview override before any ordinary scored or UCAT guidance pool.
Resolve exactly one of Home standard, Home contextual scored, International or Graduate A100.

For a Home scored route, derive the UCAT decile from the applicant's raw score through the shared lookup, preferring a university-specific table and otherwise using the global UCAT decile dataset; return insufficient evidence only if neither is usable.
Apply only the matching historical guidance band and display every historical-guidance warning.

sjt_policy.instruction: Do not read, score, rank, reject or change a guidance band using SJT.

current_cycle_ucat_deciles.instruction: Derive the decile internally from the applicant's UCAT total. Do not request a decile from the applicant and do not expose lookup details in the result card.

Manchester Access Programme / Preston Widening Access Programme — Manchester

required_pool_facts: official current-cycle Home application score available
official current-cycle Home application score available

graduate_a100.guidance_outcome: UCAT-ranking guidance only; no numerical interview band can be returned.

do_not_infer: Do not invent or estimate current-cycle UCAT decile boundaries.
Do not treat any historical application score or UCAT value as a current hard cut-off.
Do not present a historical guidance band as an interview probability, guarantee or deterministic ranking outcome.
Do not use SJT for eligibility or interview selection and do not reject SJT Band 4.
Do not automate the International personal-statement or non-academic review.
Do not create a numerical Graduate boundary from another applicant pool.
Do not return a UKWPMED guaranteed interview unless programme completion, UCAS declaration and every Birmingham Appendix 1 threshold are verified.
Do not merge UKWPMED with the Home contextual scored route.

score_model.basis: Pool-specific Birmingham interview guidance: official Home application score using the shared UCAT decile lookup, raw UCAT ranking for International and Graduate routes, and a separate all-requirements UKWPMED guaranteed-interview override.

band_derivation.home_standard: Use the single supplied 2025-entry historical minimum application score only: at or above is Strong Interview Potential (interview_likely) guidance and below is high-risk guidance. No realistic or ambitious boundary is invented.
band_derivation.home_contextual_scored: Use the single supplied 2025-entry historical minimum application score only: at or above is Strong Interview Potential (interview_likely) guidance and below is high-risk guidance. No realistic or ambitious boundary is invented.
band_derivation.international: Use only the observed minimum and maximum of the supplied 2022-2025 historical minimum UCAT series: above the observed maximum is interview-likely guidance, within the observed range is realistic guidance and below the observed minimum is high-risk guidance. No ambitious boundary is invented.
band_derivation.graduate_a100: No numerical band rules because no official historical Graduate UCAT boundary was supplied.
band_derivation.ukwpmed_guaranteed_interview: No numerical band rules; the separate verified all-conditions override determines guaranteed-interview status.
